about: Outside records about a seller: company registers, chambers of commerce, trade fairs, sanctions lists and website traffic. Used to look a seller up outside the page it sells on, in marketplace scans and website checks.
how_to_change: Each country has its own file next to this one (china.json, usa.json...). Safely reads the seller's country from the page and runs global.json plus that country's file. A country with no file gets global.json only.
sources: the outside records Safely will read. status 'planned' means not built yet; 'live' means Safely reads it now.
access: 'offline' (checked inside Safely, no internet), 'api' (free official API), 'download' (a public list file), 'scrape' (read the website), 'paid_api'.
cost: 'free', 'small_fee' or 'paid'. key_env: the name of the key in .env on the server (the key itself is never written here).
step: the build step that adds the source (see claude/databases-plan.md in the Safely project).
cards: same as b2b.json (warning_points, points_when_value, enabled). Every database card has group 'outside_records', so the extension and dashboard can show them in their own section.
Found = a good sign. Not found = NOT a warning. Only a false claim (fake company number, fake fair) or a sanctions match is a warning.

sources.name: Sanctions lists (US OFAC, UN)
sources.what_it_does: Is the company on a US or UN banned list? Downloaded once a day; only companies, whole names.

sources.name: EU sanctions list
sources.what_it_does: Is the company on the EU banned list?

sources.name: GLEIF (LEI register)
sources.what_it_does: Official world register of company IDs (LEI). Bigger companies only. Searched by the whole company name; needs GLEIF_CHECK_ENABLED=true.

sources.name: Wayback Machine
sources.what_it_does: Since when the website has existed with real content.

sources.name: Tranco list
sources.what_it_does: Is the website in the top 1 million sites (real traffic)?

sources.name: crt.sh
sources.what_it_does: When the website first got a security certificate.

sources.name: OpenCorporates
sources.what_it_does: Company registers of many countries in one place.

sources.name: Shipping records (Panjiva, ImportGenius)
sources.what_it_does: Does the company really ship goods?

cards.what_it_checks: Whether a company with exactly the seller's name is on the US (OFAC) or UN sanctions lists. A match is a warning (it may be another company with the same name); no match is a good sign but says nothing more. Needs SANCTIONS_CHECK_ENABLED=true in .env.

Whether a company with exactly the seller's name is in the official GLEIF register (LEI). Registered in the seller's country is a good sign; listed as closed is a warning; the same name in another country, or not in the register, is information only and never adds to the score. Needs GLEIF_CHECK_ENABLED=true in .env.
